Constantius Gallus.fact: Constantina left first, in order to gain some of her brother's trust, but suddenly died from a fever at Caeni Gallicani in Bithynia.

Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The King also appoints the Je Khenpo (below) as the spiritual leader of Bhutan. Finally, as indicated above, the King appoints 2 of the 4 members of the Privy Council.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Either must be upon a motion passed by a joint sitting of _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Either must be upon a motion passed by a joint sitting of Parliament. The motion for abdication must be tabled for discussion at a joint sitting of Parliament (presided by the Chief Justice of Bhutan) if at least two-thirds of the total number of the members of Parliament submits such a motion stating its basis and grounds.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The King may respond to the motion in writing or by addressing the joint sitting of _____ in person or through a representative
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Either must be upon a motion passed by a joint sitting of Parliament. The motion for abdication must be tabled for discussion at a joint sitting of Parliament (presided by the Chief Justice of Bhutan) if at least two-thirds of the total number of the members of Parliament submits such a motion stating its basis and grounds.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: If the _____ passes in all the Dzongkhags in the Kingdom, the King must abdicate in favour of the heir apparent
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: If, at such joint sitting of Parliament, at least three-fourths of the total number of members of Parliament passes the motion for abdication, then such a resolution is placed before the people in a National Referendum to be approved or rejected. If the National Referendum passes in all the Dzongkhags in the Kingdom, the King must abdicate in favour of the heir apparent.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The sole _____ exception is the King under the Chhoe-sid-nyi (dual system of religion and politics)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The sole Constitutional exception is the King under the Chhoe-sid-nyi (dual system of religion and politics).

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Thus, while religion and politics are officially separate, the _____ is the state religion of Bhutan
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Thus, while religion and politics are officially separate, the Buddhist Drukpa Lineage is the state religion of Bhutan.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The King appoints the _____ on the recommendation of the Five Lopons (teachers)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The King appoints the Je Khenpo on the recommendation of the Five Lopons (teachers). The Je Khenpo must be a learned and respected monk ordained in accordance with the Druk-lu tradition, having the nine qualities of a spiritual master and accomplished in ked-dzog.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Je Khenpo must be a learned and respected monk ordained in accordance with the _____-lu tradition, having the nine qualities of a spiritual master and accomplished in ked-dzog
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Thus, while religion and politics are officially separate, the Buddhist Drukpa Lineage is the state religion of Bhutan. The Je Khenpo must be a learned and respected monk ordained in accordance with the Druk-lu tradition, having the nine qualities of a spiritual master and accomplished in ked-dzog.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Zhung Dratshang and _____ (monastic bodies in the dzongs other than Punakha and Thimphu) are to receive adequate funds and other facilities from the State
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Zhung Dratshang and Rabdeys (monastic bodies in the dzongs other than Punakha and Thimphu) are to receive adequate funds and other facilities from the State.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution allows _____ to enact any such legislation as may be necessary to advance the cause of the cultural enrichment of Bhutanese society
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution allows Parliament to enact any such legislation as may be necessary to advance the cause of the cultural enrichment of Bhutanese society.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Second, "citizens by registration" are those who can prove domicile in Bhutan by December 31, _____ by showing registration in the official record of the Government of Bhutan
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Second, "citizens by registration" are those who can prove domicile in Bhutan by December 31, 1958 by showing registration in the official record of the Government of Bhutan.

Constitution of Bhutan.fact: They must also renounce the citizenship, if any, of a foreign State on being conferred Bhutanese citizenship; and take a solemn Oath of Allegiance to the Constitution as may be prescribed. If citizens of Bhutan acquire another citizenship, their Bhutanese citizenship is terminated.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: If citizens of Bhutan acquire another citizenship, their _____ citizenship is terminated
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: They must also renounce the citizenship, if any, of a foreign State on being conferred Bhutanese citizenship; and take a solemn Oath of Allegiance to the Constitution as may be prescribed. If citizens of Bhutan acquire another citizenship, their Bhutanese citizenship is terminated.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The grant of citizenship by naturalization takes effect by a _____ (written order) of the King
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The grant of citizenship by naturalization takes effect by a Royal Kasho (written order) of the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution confers the power to regulate all matters relating to citizenship to Parliament, subject to the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution confers the power to regulate all matters relating to citizenship to Parliament, subject to the Citizenship Acts.

Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Common Law concepts of "eminent domain" and "just compensation.") Constitution of Bhutan.fact: All persons have the right to consult and be represented by a Bhutanese jabmi (attorney) of their choice (right to counsel). Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: All persons must respect the _____ and the National Anthem
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: All persons must respect the National Flag and the National Anthem.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Bhutanese citizens must render national service when called upon to do so by _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Bhutanese citizens must render national service when called upon to do so by Parliament.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The State endeavours to apply _____ to ensure a good quality of life for the people of Bhutan in a progressive and prosperous country that is committed to peace and amity in the world
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The State endeavours to apply State Policy to ensure a good quality of life for the people of Bhutan in a progressive and prosperous country that is committed to peace and amity in the world.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It strives to promote conditions that will enable the pursuit of _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It strives to promote conditions that will enable the pursuit of Gross National Happiness.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Thus, the State's policy in carrying out its objectives is somewhat _____-socialist
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Crossing into religion, the State strives to create conditions that will enable the true and sustainable development of a good and compassionate society rooted in Buddhist ethos and universal human values. Thus, the State's policy in carrying out its objectives is somewhat Buddhist-socialist.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution defines the _____'s role in finance, trade and commerce
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution defines the Government's role in finance, trade and commerce. It authorizes the Government to raise loans, make grants, or guarantee loans.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It authorizes the _____ to raise loans, make grants, or guarantee loans
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution defines the Government's role in finance, trade and commerce. It authorizes the Government to raise loans, make grants, or guarantee loans.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It also sets up a regulatory framework for the _____, Bhutan's general public assets
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It also sets up a regulatory framework for the Consolidated Fund, Bhutan's general public assets.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The legislative branch is the bicameral _____ of Bhutan
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The legislative branch is the bicameral Parliament of Bhutan. Within these branches of government, only members of the executive and the National Assembly (the lower house of Parliament) may hold political party affiliations.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The executive branch is the _____ (cabinet), headed by the Prime Minister and supported by subsidiary government agencies
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The executive branch is the Lhengye Zhungtshog (cabinet), headed by the Prime Minister and supported by subsidiary government agencies.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The politically independent judicial branch is the _____ of Justice, which is reviewed by the Supreme Court of Bhutan
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The politically independent judicial branch is the Royal Court of Justice, which is reviewed by the Supreme Court of Bhutan.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Within these branches of government, only members of the executive and the _____ (the lower house of Parliament) may hold political party affiliations
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Within these branches of government, only members of the executive and the National Assembly (the lower house of Parliament) may hold political party affiliations.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Bhutan's international territorial boundaries and internal _____ and Gewog divisions may be altered only with the consent of at least three-fourths of the total number of members of Parliament
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Bhutan's international territorial boundaries and internal Dzongkhag and Gewog divisions may be altered only with the consent of at least three-fourths of the total number of members of Parliament. It consists of 25 members: one directly elected from each of the 20 Dzongkhags (Districts) and 5 appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It consists of 25 members: one directly elected from each of the 20 _____ (Districts) and 5 appointed by the King
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It consists of 25 members: one directly elected from each of the 20 Dzongkhags (Districts) and 5 appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The membership elects a _____ and Deputy Chairperson from its number
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The membership elects a Chairperson and Deputy Chairperson from its number.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Members and candidates of the _____ are prohibited from holding political party affiliation
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The National Council meets at least twice a year. Members and candidates of the National Council are prohibited from holding political party affiliation.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It consists of a maximum of 55 members directly elected by the citizens of constituencies within each _____ (District)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It consists of a maximum of 55 members directly elected by the citizens of constituencies within each Dzongkhag (District). Under this system of proportional representation, each constituency is represented by one National Assembly member; each of the 20 Dzongkhags must be represented by between 2–7 members.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Under this system of proportional representation, each constituency is represented by one _____ member; each of the 20 Dzongkhags must be represented by between 2–7 members
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The National Assembly of Bhutan is the lower house of parliament. Under this system of proportional representation, each constituency is represented by one National Assembly member; each of the 20 Dzongkhags must be represented by between 2–7 members.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The National Assembly meets at least twice a year, and elects a Speaker and _____ from among its members
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The National Assembly meets at least twice a year, and elects a Speaker and Deputy Speaker from among its members.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Bills are ultimately subject to veto and modification by the King, however the King must assent to bills resubmitted after joint sitting and deliberation by the _____ and National Assembly
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Bhutanese legislation must be presented bicamerally, at times in joint sitting of the National Council and National Assembly, however bills may pass by default without vote when none is conducted before the close of the present session. Bills are ultimately subject to veto and modification by the King, however the King must assent to bills resubmitted after joint sitting and deliberation by the National Council and National Assembly.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The National Assembly may, with support of at least one third of its members, motion of no confidence in the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The National Assembly may, with support of at least one third of its members, motion of no confidence in the Government. If the vote passes with at least two-thirds support, the King must dismiss the Government.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: If the vote passes with at least two-thirds support, the King must dismiss the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The National Assembly may, with support of at least one third of its members, motion of no confidence in the Government. If the vote passes with at least two-thirds support, the King must dismiss the Government.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution defines the rights and duties of the opposition party in _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution defines the rights and duties of the opposition party in Parliament.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution sets forth the procedure of the formation of government and its ministries, providing for the post of _____ and the other Ministers of Bhutan
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution sets forth the procedure of the formation of government and its ministries, providing for the post of Prime Minister and the other Ministers of Bhutan. The King recognizes the leader or nominee of the party that wins the majority of seats in the National Assembly as the Prime Minister.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The King recognizes the leader or nominee of the party that wins the majority of seats in the _____ as the Prime Minister
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The King recognizes the leader or nominee of the party that wins the majority of seats in the National Assembly as the Prime Minister. Other Ministers are appointed from among National Assembly members by the King on advice of the Prime Minister.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Other Ministers are appointed from among _____ members by the King on advice of the Prime Minister
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The King recognizes the leader or nominee of the party that wins the majority of seats in the National Assembly as the Prime Minister. Other Ministers are appointed from among National Assembly members by the King on advice of the Prime Minister.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: There is a limit of two _____ from any one Dzongkhag
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Other Ministers are appointed from among National Assembly members by the King on advice of the Prime Minister. There is a limit of two Ministers from any one Dzongkhag.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The number of other _____ is determined by the number of Ministries required to provide efficient and good governance
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Other Ministers are appointed from among National Assembly members by the King on advice of the Prime Minister. There is a limit of two Ministers from any one Dzongkhag.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Chief Justice of Bhutan, _____ (Associate Justices) of the Supreme Court are appointed by the King
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Supreme Court of Bhutan, which comprises the Chief Justice and four Drangpons, is the highest appellate authority to entertain appeals against the judgments, orders, or decisions of the High Court in all matters. The Chief Justice of Bhutan, Drangpons (Associate Justices) of the Supreme Court are appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The term of office of the _____ of Bhutan is five years (or until attaining age 65)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Supreme Court of Bhutan, which comprises the Chief Justice and four Drangpons, is the highest appellate authority to entertain appeals against the judgments, orders, or decisions of the High Court in all matters. The Chief Justice of Bhutan, Drangpons (Associate Justices) of the Supreme Court are appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The term of office of the _____ and the Drangpons of the High Court is 10 years (or until attaining age 60)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Supreme Court of Bhutan, which comprises the Chief Justice and four Drangpons, is the highest appellate authority to entertain appeals against the judgments, orders, or decisions of the High Court in all matters. The Chief Justice of Bhutan, Drangpons (Associate Justices) of the Supreme Court are appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: That of the Drangpons of the _____ is ten years (or until attaining age 65)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Supreme Court is a court of record. The Chief Justice of Bhutan, Drangpons (Associate Justices) of the Supreme Court are appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Chief Justice and _____ of the High Court of Bhutan are appointed by the King
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The King appoints most of the upper Judicial branch: the Chief Justice of Bhutan and the Drangpons (Associate Justices) of the Supreme Court; the Chief Justice and Drangpons (Associate Justices) of the High Court.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The judges of the _____ and Dungkhag Courts are not appointed by the King
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The High Court of Bhutan, which comprises a Chief Justice and eight Drangpons, is the court of appeal from the Dzongkhag Courts and Tribunals in all matters and exercises original jurisdiction in matters not within the jurisdiction of the Dzongkhag Courts and Tribunals. The judges of the Dzongkhag and Dungkhag Courts are not appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Supreme Court and the _____ may issue such declarations, orders, directions or writs as may be appropriate in the circumstances of each case
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The High Court of Bhutan, which comprises a Chief Justice and eight Drangpons, is the court of appeal from the Dzongkhag Courts and Tribunals in all matters and exercises original jurisdiction in matters not within the jurisdiction of the Dzongkhag Courts and Tribunals. The Supreme Court and the High Court may issue such declarations, orders, directions or writs as may be appropriate in the circumstances of each case.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Parliament may, by law, establish impartial and independent _____ as well as Alternative Dispute Resolution centres
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Parliament may, by law, establish impartial and independent Administrative Tribunals as well as Alternative Dispute Resolution centres.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The King appoints the four members of the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: By command of the King and upon the recommendation of the National Judicial Commission, Drangpons of the Supreme Court and the High Court may be punished by censure and suspension for proven misbehaviour that does not deserve impeachment in the opinion of the Commission. The King appoints the four members of the National Judicial Commission.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Local Governments are entitled to levy, collect, and appropriate taxes, duties, tolls, and fees in accordance with procedures provided for by _____ by law
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Local Governments are entitled to levy, collect, and appropriate taxes, duties, tolls, and fees in accordance with procedures provided for by Parliament by law. Local Governments are also entitled to own assets and incur liabilities by borrowing on their own account subject to such limitations as may be provided for by Parliament by law.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Local Governments are also entitled to own assets and incur liabilities by borrowing on their own account subject to such limitations as may be provided for by _____ by law
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Local Governments are entitled to levy, collect, and appropriate taxes, duties, tolls, and fees in accordance with procedures provided for by Parliament by law. Local Governments are also entitled to own assets and incur liabilities by borrowing on their own account subject to such limitations as may be provided for by Parliament by law.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: There are 20 _____ (Districts) in all of Bhutan, each headed by a Dzongdag appointed by the King as the chief executive supported by civil servants
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: There are 20 Dzongkhags (Districts) in all of Bhutan, each headed by a Dzongdag appointed by the King as the chief executive supported by civil servants.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Each Dzongkhag is also represented by a _____ (District Council)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution divides Local Government into three tiers: Dzongkhag Tshogdu (District Council at the highest local level), Gewog Tshogde (County Committee at the intermediate local level) and Thromde Tshogde (Municipal Committee at the most local level). Each Dzongkhag is also represented by a Dzongkhag Tshogdu (District Council).

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Membership of the _____ depends on the number of Gewogs within the Dzongkhag
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Each Dzongkhag is also represented by a Dzongkhag Tshogdu (District Council). Membership of the Dzongkhag Tshogdu depends on the number of Gewogs within the Dzongkhag.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Each Gewog is represented on the _____ by two members, its Gup and Mangmi (below)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Each Dzongkhag is also represented by a Dzongkhag Tshogdu (District Council). Membership of the Dzongkhag Tshogdu depends on the number of Gewogs within the Dzongkhag.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Two further members of the _____ are one elected representative from the Dzongkhag Thromde (District municipality) and one elected representative from Dzongkhag Yenlag Thromde (satellite towns)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Each Dzongkhag is also represented by a Dzongkhag Tshogdu (District Council). Membership of the Dzongkhag Tshogdu depends on the number of Gewogs within the Dzongkhag.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Dzongkhag Tshogdu elects a _____ from among its members and meets at least twice a year
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Dzongkhag Tshogdu elects a Chairperson from among its members and meets at least twice a year.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Dzongkhags are divided into _____ (Counties or Blocks), numbering 205 in all of Bhutan
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Dzongkhags are divided into Gewogs (Counties or Blocks), numbering 205 in all of Bhutan.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: These are in turn subdivided into _____ for election purposes
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: These are in turn subdivided into Chiwogs for election purposes. Other Tshogpas (Representatives) are directly elected by citizens of Chiwogs.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Each Gewog is represented by a _____ (County Committee), headed by a Gup (Head of Gewog) and a Mangmi (deputy), both of whom are directly elected by citizens
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Each Gewog is represented by a Gewog Tshogde (County Committee), headed by a Gup (Head of Gewog) and a Mangmi (deputy), both of whom are directly elected by citizens. The membership of each Gewog Tshogde must comprise between 7–10 members and meet at least three times annually.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The membership of each _____ must comprise between 7–10 members and meet at least three times annually
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Each Gewog is represented by a Gewog Tshogde (County Committee), headed by a Gup (Head of Gewog) and a Mangmi (deputy), both of whom are directly elected by citizens. The membership of each Gewog Tshogde must comprise between 7–10 members and meet at least three times annually.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Other Tshogpas (_____) are directly elected by citizens of Chiwogs
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Other Tshogpas (Representatives) are directly elected by citizens of Chiwogs.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: On the most local level, a _____ (Municipal Committee) is headed by a Thrompon (Mayor), who is directly elected by the voters of the Dzongkhag Thromde
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: On the most local level, a Thromde Tshogde (Municipal Committee) is headed by a Thrompon (Mayor), who is directly elected by the voters of the Dzongkhag Thromde. The other members of the Thromde Tshogde are elected directly by citizens divided into constituencies.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The other members of the _____ are elected directly by citizens divided into constituencies
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: On the most local level, a Thromde Tshogde (Municipal Committee) is headed by a Thrompon (Mayor), who is directly elected by the voters of the Dzongkhag Thromde. The other members of the Thromde Tshogde are elected directly by citizens divided into constituencies.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The powers and functions of the _____ are defined by Parliament
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: On the most local level, a Thromde Tshogde (Municipal Committee) is headed by a Thrompon (Mayor), who is directly elected by the voters of the Dzongkhag Thromde. The powers and functions of the Thrompon are defined by Parliament.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Like the _____, the Thromde Tshogde must comprise between 7–10 members and meet at least three times annually
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Like the Gewog Tshogde, the Thromde Tshogde must comprise between 7–10 members and meet at least three times annually.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution establishes a two-thirds quorum requirement in order to conduct any business on _____ levels
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution establishes a two-thirds quorum requirement in order to conduct any business on Local Government levels. Notably, candidates and members of the Local Governments are banned from political party affiliation.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It also defines local electoral procedure in terms of _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It also defines local electoral procedure in terms of Parliamentary Electoral Laws.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Notably, candidates and members of the _____ are banned from political party affiliation
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Notably, candidates and members of the Local Governments are banned from political party affiliation.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Two political parties are elected to the _____, established through a primary election in which all registered political parties may participate
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Two political parties are elected to the National Assembly, set up through a primary election in which all registered political parties may participate.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Political parties must be registered by the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Political parties must be registered by the Election Commission.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Registration requires their members to be _____ citizens and not otherwise disqualified, and that membership not be based on region, sex, language, religion or social origin
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Registration requires their members to be Bhutanese citizens and not otherwise disqualified, and that membership not be based on region, sex, language, religion or social origin.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society

Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: The President of Uzbekistan, who is directly elected to a five-year term that can be renewed once, is the head of state and is granted supreme executive power by the constitution. Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: The 150 deputies to the _____ (lower house) of the bicameral Oliy Majlis, the highest legislative body, are elected to five-year terms

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society

Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: The Oliy Majlis enacts legislation, which may be initiated by the President, within the parliament, by the high courts, by the procurator general (highest law enforcement official in the country), or by the government of the Autonomous Republic of Karakalpakstan. Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society

Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: Besides legislation, international treaties, presidential decrees, and states of emergency also must be ratified by the Oliy Majlis. Judges at all levels are appointed by the President and approved by the Oliy Majlis.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: – _____ 9: Major matters of public and state life shall be submitted for a nationwide discussion and put to a direct vote of the people (a referendum)
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: – Article 8: The people of Uzbekistan consists of the citizens of the Republic of Uzbekistan irrespective of their nationality. – Article 9: Major matters of public and state life shall be submitted for a nationwide discussion and put to a direct vote of the people (a referendum).

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: – Article 10: Only the _____ (Oliy Majlis) and the President of the Republic, elected by the people, can act on behalf of the people of Uzbekistan
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: – Article 10: Only the National Assembly (Oliy Majlis) and the President of the Republic, elected by the people, can act on behalf of the people of Uzbekistan.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: – _____ 16: None of the provisions of the present Constitution shall be interpreted in a way detrimental to the rights and interests of the Republic of Uzbekistan
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: – Article 14: The state bases its activity on the principles of social justice and legality in the interest of well-being of man and society. – Article 16: None of the provisions of the present Constitution shall be interpreted in a way detrimental to the rights and interests of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: – _____ 19: Both citizens of the Republic of Uzbekistan and the state shall be bound by mutual rights and mutual responsibility
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: – Article 19: Both citizens of the Republic of Uzbekistan and the state shall be bound by mutual rights and mutual responsibility. – Article 20: The exercise of rights and freedoms by a citizen shall not encroach on the lawful interests, rights and freedoms of other citizens, the state or society.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: – _____ 20: The exercise of rights and freedoms by a citizen shall not encroach on the lawful interests, rights and freedoms of other citizens, the state or society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: – Article 19: Both citizens of the Republic of Uzbekistan and the state shall be bound by mutual rights and mutual responsibility. – Article 20: The exercise of rights and freedoms by a citizen shall not encroach on the lawful interests, rights and freedoms of other citizens, the state or society.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society

Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: Citizenship in the Republic of Uzbekistan shall be equal for all regardless of the grounds of its acquisition. Every citizen of the Republic of Karakalpakstan shall be a citizen of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: Every citizen of the _____ of Karakalpakstan shall be a citizen of the Republic of Uzbekistan
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: Citizenship in the Republic of Uzbekistan shall be equal for all regardless of the grounds of its acquisition. Every citizen of the Republic of Karakalpakstan shall be a citizen of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: – Article 22: _____ of Uzbekistan shall guarantee legal protection to all its citizens both on the territory of the republic and abroad
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: Citizenship in the Republic of Uzbekistan shall be equal for all regardless of the grounds of its acquisition. Every citizen of the Republic of Karakalpakstan shall be a citizen of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: They shall perform the duties established by the Constitution, laws, and international agreements signed by the _____ of Uzbekistan
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: – Article 22: The Republic of Uzbekistan shall guarantee legal protection to all its citizens both on the territory of the republic and abroad. – Article 23: Foreign citizens and stateless persons, during their stay on the territory of the Republic of Uzbekistan, shall be guaranteed the rights and freedoms in accordance with the norms of international law.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: – _____ 25: Everyone shall have the right to freedom and inviolability of the person
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: – Article 23: Foreign citizens and stateless persons, during their stay on the territory of the Republic of Uzbekistan, shall be guaranteed the rights and freedoms in accordance with the norms of international law. – Article 25: Everyone shall have the right to freedom and inviolability of the person.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: – _____ 26: No one may be adjudged guilty of a crime except by the sentence of a court and in conformity with the law
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: – Article 25: Everyone shall have the right to freedom and inviolability of the person. – Article 26: No one may be adjudged guilty of a crime except by the sentence of a court and in conformity with the law.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: – _____ 27: Everyone shall be entitled to protection against encroachments on his honour, dignity, and interference in his private life, and shall be guaranteed inviolability of the home
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: – Article 27: Everyone shall be entitled to protection against encroachments on his honour, dignity, and interference in his private life, and shall be guaranteed inviolability of the home. – Article 28: Any citizen of the Republic of Uzbekistan shall have the right to freedom of movement on the territory of the Republic, as well as a free entry to and exit from it, except in the events specified by law.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: – _____ 29: Everyone shall be guaranteed freedom of thought, speech and convictions
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: – Article 27: Everyone shall be entitled to protection against encroachments on his honour, dignity, and interference in his private life, and shall be guaranteed inviolability of the home. – Article 28: Any citizen of the Republic of Uzbekistan shall have the right to freedom of movement on the territory of the Republic, as well as a free entry to and exit from it, except in the events specified by law.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: – _____ 31: Freedom of conscience is guaranteed to all
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: – Article 30: All state bodies, public associations and officials in the Republic of Uzbekistan shall allow any citizen access to documents, resolutions and other materials, relating to their rights and interests. – Article 31: Freedom of conscience is guaranteed to all.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: The new version of the constitution should come into force from the day of the official publication of the results of the referendum by the _____
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: The new version of the constitution should come into force from the day of the official publication of the results of the referendum by the Central Election Commission.

Constitution of Uzbekistan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Uzbekistan.question: The number of articles of the _____ in the draft has been increased from 128 in the current Constitution to 155
Constitution of Uzbekistan.fact: The number of articles of the Basic Law in the draft has been increased from 128 in the current Constitution to 155.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: The _____ was Supreme law of Vietnam.
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: The Constitution of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (Vietnamese: Hiến pháp nước Cộng hòa xã hội chủ nghĩa Việt Nam) is the communist state constitution of Vietnam.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: _____ Constitution of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam, adopted on December 31, 1959
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: 1959 Constitution of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam, adopted on December 31, 1959.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: The former Republic of Vietnam also had two constitutions, adopted in _____ and 1967
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: The former Republic of Vietnam also had two constitutions, adopted in 1956 and 1967.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: Neither of these constitutional documents is in force, as the _____ Constitution was abrogated when the government of the Republic of Vietnam collapsed in 1975
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: The former Republic of Vietnam also had two constitutions, adopted in 1956 and 1967. Neither of these constitutional documents is in force, as the 1967 Constitution was abrogated when the government of the Republic of Vietnam collapsed in 1975.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: Upon political reunification of the country in _____, the 1960 Constitution of the Democratic Republic became the constitution of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: Upon political reunification of the country in 1976, the 1960 Constitution of the Democratic Republic became the constitution of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: Since then, the Vietnamese government adopted two constitutions before the _____ Constitution: 1980 Constitution of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, adopted on December 19, 1980
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: Since then, the Vietnamese government adopted two constitutions before the 2013 Constitution: 1980 Constitution of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, adopted on December 19, 1980.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: _____ Constitution of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, adopted on April 25, 1992, and amended in 2001
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: 1992 Constitution of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, adopted on April 25, 1992, and amended in 2001.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: According to the _____ constitution, the president of the republic, was the head of government, rather than a ceremonial head of state
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: According to the 1946 constitution, the president of the republic, was the head of government, rather than a ceremonial head of state.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: The later _____ constitution turned the president into a ceremonial head, while giving de facto power to the party leader
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: The later 1959 constitution turned the president into a ceremonial head, while giving de facto power to the party leader.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: Its preamble defined the DRV as a "people's democratic state led by the working class", thus codifying the actual state of affairs that had prevailed since _____
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: Its preamble defined the DRV as a "people's democratic state led by the working class", thus codifying the actual state of affairs that had prevailed since 1945.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: On paper, the legislative function was carried out by the _____
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: On paper, the legislative function was carried out by the National Assembly. Together those elected (including the president and vice president) formed a Council of Ministers, which constitutionally (but not in practice) was subject to supervision by the Standing Committee of the National Assembly.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: Besides overseeing the _____ of Ministers, the assembly's Standing Committee nominally supervised the Supreme People's Court, the chief organ of the judiciary
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: Together those elected (including the president and vice president) formed a Council of Ministers, which constitutionally (but not in practice) was subject to supervision by the Standing Committee of the National Assembly. Headed by a prime minister, the council was the highest executive organ of state authority.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: In reality, however, the final authority on all matters rested with the _____
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: In reality, however, the final authority on all matters rested with the Political Bureau.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: The _____ Constitution was drafted when Vietnam faced a serious threat from China, and political and economic dependence on the Soviet Union had increased
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: The 1980 Constitution was drafted when Vietnam faced a serious threat from China, and political and economic dependence on the Soviet Union had increased.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: The reunification of North and South Vietnam (the former Republic of Vietnam) in _____ provided the primary motivation for revising the 1959 constitution
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: The reunification of North and South Vietnam (the former Republic of Vietnam) in 1976 provided the primary motivation for revising the 1959 constitution. Revisions were made along ideological lines set forth at the Fourth National Congress of the Vietnamese Communist Party (VCP) in 1976, emphasizing popular sovereignty and promising success in undertaking "revolutions" in production, science and technology, culture, and ideology.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: The _____ Vietnamese Constitution concentrates power in a newly established Council of State, much like the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet, endowing it nominally with both legislative and executive p
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: The 1980 Vietnamese Constitution concentrates power in a newly set up Council of State, much like the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet, endowing it nominally with both legislative and executive powers.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: Many functions of the legislature remain the same as under the _____ document, but others have been transferred to the executive branch or assigned to both branches concurrently
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: Many functions of the legislature remain the same as under the 1959 document, but others have been transferred to the executive branch or assigned to both branches concurrently.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: The role of the _____ of Ministers, while appearing on paper to have been subordinated to the new Council of State, in practice retained its former primacy
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: The 1980 Vietnamese Constitution concentrates power in a newly set up Council of State, much like the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet, endowing it nominally with both legislative and executive powers. The executive branch appears strengthened overall, having gained a second major executive body, the Council of State, and the importance of the National Assembly appears to have been reduced accordingly.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: Among the innovative features of the _____ document is the concept of "collective mastery" of society, a frequently used expression attributed to the late party secretary Le Duan (1907 - 1986)
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: Among the innovative features of the 1980 document is the concept of "collective mastery" of society, a frequently used expression attributed to the late party secretary Le Duan (1907 - 1986).

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: The concept is a _____ version of popular sovereignty, which advocates an active role for the people so that they may become their own masters as well as masters of society, nature, and the nation
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: The concept is a Vietnamese version of popular sovereignty, which advocates an active role for the people so that they may become their own masters as well as masters of society, nature, and the nation.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: On paper, these organizations, to which almost all citizens belong, play an active role in government and have the right to introduce bills before the _____
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: On paper, these organizations, to which almost all citizens belong, play an active role in government and have the right to introduce bills before the National Assembly.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: The _____ Constitution comprises 147 articles, in 12 chapters, dealing with numerous subjects, including the basic rights and duties of citizens
Constitution of Vietnam.fact: The 1980 Constitution comprises 147 articles, in 12 chapters, dealing with numerous subjects, including the basic rights and duties of citizens.

Constitution of Vietnam.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Vietnam.question: The _____ constitution adopted the socialist-oriented market economy, which allowed the development of private economic sectors, but it largely retained the previous constitutional structure
